notes: Segment operating profits do not mechanically sum to consolidated operating income due to different segment scopes and eliminations.

Other is the company's own aggregated factor, not a verified single causal source.
FY2027 numbers and outlook refer to the fiscal year ending March 2027. Actuals are the quarter ended June 2026.
